description: This file defines the AttributeValue class which models an attribute value within the catalog module of the shopizer e-commerce platform. It extends ShopEntity and includes properties such as name, description, default attribute flag, image, and price, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: AttributeValue
classes.description: Represents an attribute value in the product catalog, including properties like name, description, default flag, image, and price.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the attribute value.

methods.name: isDefaultAttribute
methods.description: Returns whether this attribute value is the default.

methods.name: setDefaultAttribute
methods.description: Sets whether this attribute value is the default.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image associated with this attribute value.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with this attribute value.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price associated with this attribute value.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price for this attribute value.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attribute value.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for this attribute value.
